name: Valor Equity Partners
identity_check: Valor Equity Partners (valorep.com), the private investment firm founded by Antonio Gracias; its site lists SpaceX, Addepar, BitGo and Dataminr. Crusoe coverage names Valor Equity Partners as co-lead; Flow Engineering's release names Gracias as Valor's founder. The Valor Atreides AI Fund is a Valor-branded vehicle (Bedrock round), distinct from Atreides Management (Gavin Baker's separate firm, which co-invests with Valor). Not Valor Capital Group (Brazil/US).
